complete_examples.text: Inspired by Ref. [13,27,29], a robust and effective method is proposed to inverse the wheel-rail forces by integrating the physical model and deep learning method, which includes a novel hybrid recursive CNN-LSTM and the forward recursive prediction modules.

Furthermore, a novel hybrid recursive CNN-LSTM deep learning architecture is developed to learn the data relationships be tween the vibration response of the train parts and wheel-rail forces, and the forward recursive prediction model is utilized to achieve the inver sion of wheel-rail forces.
